✨ drip | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling developers to securely expose local development servers or services to the internet for testing, collaboration, or public access, while maintaining full control over their infrastructure and data.
✨ Key Features: • Self-hosted tunneling • Secure exposure of local services • Unlimited bandwidth and requests • No third-party servers • User control over data
📖 Summary: Drip is a self-hosted tunneling solution written in Go that allows users to securely expose local services to the internet without relying on third-party servers. It offers unlimited bandwidth and requests, and emphasizes user control over data and infrastructure.
